title: Writ purpose manifest
description: One declared purpose for one agent: who owns it, what it is for, which tools it may call under which constraints, and when the delegation ends. Deny by default is a required literal.

agent_id.description: Stable identifier of the agent. Becomes the Cedar principal Agent::"<agent_id>".

owner.description: The accountable human. Every decision record names this owner.

purpose.description: Plain-language statement of what the agent is for. Read by humans and auditors; not parsed.

purpose_id.description: Slug for the purpose. Every compiled policy is annotated with it and every call carries it in context.

allowed_tools.description: The only tools the agent may call. Anything not listed is denied.

data_classes.description: Labels for the data the agent is expected to touch. Informational today; the evidence export lists them.

credential_ttl_seconds.description: Lifetime of any credential the broker mints for this agent. One hour by default, one day at most.

expires_at.description: When the delegation ends. ISO 8601 date-time. Compiled into every policy; an expired manifest fails to load.

escalation_contact.description: Who is paged when the agent is denied and cannot proceed.

deny_by_default.description: Must be literally true. The manifest states its own posture.

name.description: Tool name exactly as the runtime reports it, for example Write, Edit, Bash, or mcp__gbrain__query.

arg_allow.description: Per-argument allow rule. An array is an exact-value allowlist; a string is a regular expression the value must match. The argument must be present.

arg_deny.description: Per-argument deny rule. An array is an exact-value denylist; a string is a regular expression the value must not match. An absent argument passes.

path_prefixes.description: The resource path must start with one of these prefixes. Forward slashes; a trailing slash means a directory.
